Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a sales and use tax exemption of materials and services used in the weatherization assistance program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the sales and use tax exemption of materials andservices used in the weatherization assistance program; adding a newsection to chapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax imposed by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales oftangible personal property or labor and services used in theweatherization of a residence under the weatherization assistanceprogram under chapter 70.164 RCW. The exemption only applies totangible personal property that becomes a component of the residence. (2) The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) "Residence" and "weatherization" have the meanings provided inRCW 70.164.020.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply to the use oftangible personal property or labor and services used in theweatherization of a residence under the weatherization assistanceprogram under chapter 70.164 RCW. The exemption only applies totangible personal property that becomes a component of the residence. (2) "Residence" and "weatherization" have the meanings provided inRCW 70.164.020.
